title: snapshot.cb integrity wrapper (format_version=2)
description: Periodic substrate derived-state snapshot wrapper (L1_SCHEMA §6). Signature over BARE payload bytes (not wrapper) — allows wrapper-schema upgrade without re-signing inner payload. Encoded via canonical-bytes serializer (L1_SCHEMA §5; Map keys strict canonical-order). Written every K cycles (seed K=1000). On boot: substrate seeds in-memory state from snapshot, then replays only past-tip events.

format_version.description: v1=legacy unsigned (load returns Ok(None), forces full replay); v2=current canonical; v3+=future.

signature.description: Ed25519 over BARE payload bytes (64 bytes). Signer = substrate_signing_keypair (F24).

signer_pubkey.description: Ed25519 substrate pubkey (32 bytes); MUST match substrate's derived pubkey from L1_SCHEMA §7. Mismatch → C38_snapshot_integrity_violation.
